source: AHA/ASA 2024 Guidelines for the Prevention of Stroke
organization: American Heart Association / American Stroke Association
recommendations: Initiate antiplatelet therapy (e.g., aspirin 81 mg/day or clopidogrel 75 mg/day)
Target blood pressure < 130/80 mmHg with antihypertensive agents
Statin therapy: High-intensity statin to target LDL-C < 70 mg/dL
Screen for atrial fibrillation using ECG or prolonged monitoring if stroke is embolic of undetermined source
Incorporate lifestyle interventions: physical activity, smoking cessation, and Mediterranean-style diet

follow_up.action: Start antithrombotic and high-intensity lipid-lowering therapy
Follow up to monitor drug adherence, side effects, and blood pressure control
Reassess lipid profile to confirm LDL-C target is achieved
Carotid duplex imaging (if history of carotid stenosis) and routine metabolic screening

contraindications.condition: Long-term use (>90 days) for secondary stroke prevention
contraindications.action: Contraindicated unless indicated for coronary interventions due to high bleeding risk

emergency_signs: BE FAST: Balance loss, Eyesight changes, Facial drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call emergency
references: 2024 Guidelines for the Prevention of Stroke in Patients with Stroke or Transient Ischemic Attack
